results.title: California
results.overview: After his mother’s death, Cipri takes over the family business: the California Hostel. There, he meets Maribel, a guest with a broken heart. Both try to cope with their pain as life at the hostel goes on.

results.title: Saving Shuli-San
results.overview: After the Israeli box office success of the first film, Avihu, Betzalel, and Natty return to theaters - this time, to save Shuli from the Japanese mafia, the Yakuza. The trio embarks on a wild adventure across Japan, along with Bat Sheva, Shuli's boss at his Tokyo restaurant job, and Roboko - a female android. Along the way, they'll have to face ninjas, the Yakuza, the crazy Japanese culture - and complete their biggest challenge: Saving Shuli. Again.

results.title: Nocturne
results.overview: In the tormented darkness of a stormy night, a child, unable to sleep, gets lost in the immensity of a house. Lightning transforms the dwelling, and an unexpected encounter will seal her nocturnal wandering.

results.title: Gustavia, l'histoire du prince de Suède inconnu
results.original_title: Gustavia, l'histoire du prince de Suède inconnu

results.title: Self Portrait
results.overview: When an artist's work is destroyed, she struggles to come to terms with her perceptions of herself as a painter.

results.title: Sundown
results.overview: Three gold miners searching for riches find a forgotten town. To survive the night, they must obey its bizarre rules, where every mistake is fatal.

results.title: Mislead
results.overview: An unexpected reunion brings three former friends back together to face a common enemy. But the real question is: who is the real enemy?

results.title: Macbeth
results.overview: Fearless and unforgettably creepy. This high-concept production, filmed live at London’s Donmar Warehouse, stars the formidable talents of David Tennant and Cush Jumbo in Shakespeare’s most infamous tragedy.

results.title: Crooked Heart
results.overview: A brutal murder shocks a quiet town. When the mutilated body of a woman is discovered, all suspicion turns toward Sơn — who may have been her lover. Triết, a renowned sculptor, is torn between doubt and brotherly love as he and his wife struggle to prove Sơn’s innocence. In the end, the question remains: is Sơn a killer, a victim of cruel fate, or a lost soul consumed by a love so destructive it leads to his own ruin?

results.title: Flock
results.overview: When the sheep population of a tight-knit farming community mysteriously vanish, an elderly Shepherd becomes the target of suspicion and anger when his meagre flock are miraculously untouched by this freak event.

results.title: The Mask: Gone Viral
results.overview: A struggling actress in Brooklyn finds the iconic Loki mask and goes on a wild, drunken escapade for the entire world to see, creating a new viral sensation.

results.title: Last Days
results.overview: Determined to fulfill his life’s mission, 26-year-old John Allen Chau embarks on a dangerous adventure across the globe to convert the uncontacted tribe of North Sentinel Island to Christianity, while a detective from the Andaman Islands races to stop him before he does harm to himself or the tribe.

results.title: Jahiziye Babam
results.overview: A man from a low-class family faces many challenges in providing his daughter's dowry.

results.title: The Quiet Son
results.overview: Pierre, a devoted father in his 50s, raises his two sons alone. When Louis, the youngest, leaves home to attend the Sorbonne in Paris, Fus, slightly older and not as successful academically, becomes more and more secretive. Driven by a fascination for violence, he gets entangled in far-right extremist groups, at the very opposite of his father’s values. Between them, there is love and hate, until tragedy happens.

results.title: Adinaasam Vellapokkam
results.overview: Four students at strict Liberty Engineering College encounter a gangster who sneaks in as a motivational speaker. The stern principal watches everyone closely as events unfold.

results.title: Shoobs
results.overview: It’s 2005 and Lisa is at a house party, receiving advice on her two crushes by a mysterious party companion.

results.title: New Acquisition
results.overview: A young couple debates keeping a painting up in their new apartment.

results.title: Single Blind
results.overview: In the near future, a man is selected to go through a memory program where his life is forever altered.

results.title: Sabik
results.overview: A wife leaves her husband to work abroad. But when her husband meets an enigmatic woman who seduces her every time their marriage is put to the test.
